key_detail: commit {{CULPRIT_COMMIT}} added app/pricing.py bulk_discount_cents, which multiplies a Decimal subtotal by float tier rates (0.05/0.10); every checkout with 3 or more different products raises TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for *: 'decimal.Decimal' and 'float' and returns 500, while carts with 1-2 products still succeed
red_herrings: pydantic 2.10.4 -> 2.10.6 dependency bump deployed to the api about six minutes before the culprit (request validation library, but patch-level and errors start only after the later deploy)
steady ~5% 4xx on /checkout, /users and /products from malformed client input (422/404), present before and after the change
worker settings change (RECONCILE_INTERVAL_S 300 -> 600) deployed after the errors started
expected_fix: revert commit {{CULPRIT_COMMIT}} or fix bulk_discount_cents to use Decimal rates (Decimal("0.05"), Decimal("0.10")) instead of floats, then redeploy the api
notes: Change applied at {{INJECT_TS}}. Only POST /checkout with 3+ distinct products fails (about half of the loadgen carts, which have 1-4 items); single- and two-item carts keep returning 201, so the error rate is partial. The app.errors 'unhandled exception' lines carry the TypeError traceback ending in app/pricing.py; the diff shows the float rates. The exception fires before the order insert and the payment call, so no orphan orders or payments.
